name: clonamic-create-agent
description: Design an agent pipeline with the user as a two-level graph (agents, then steps) in a local web editor, review it objectively, and export implementation-neutral Korean design documents with one explicit /clonamic-create-agent command.

interface.shortDescription: Design an agent pipeline as a graph and export Korean design docs on an explicit command.
interface.longDescription: One command, /clonamic-create-agent, opens a local web editor where you and the agent design a pipeline as agents and their steps, connected by plain or conditional links. A reviewer evaluates the design against ranked criteria and proposes changes you apply with one click. Export writes implementation-neutral Korean design documents: a Mermaid overview, agent, step, and link documents, a glossary, and a change log.
defaultPrompt: Use Clonamic Create Agent to design an agent pipeline.
